dossiers.summary: One of ten buildings the state certified on a single day, each under its own numbered Vantage entity, with Oracle as occupant on every one. Vantage has said its Shackelford County campus is ten data centers.

notes.text: The count matches. Vantage announced a campus of ten data centers and the state certified ten numbered buildings on one day with the same occupant. That correspondence is not a statement from either party and it is not published here as one.
Vantage holds other Texas certifications under lower numbers, filed separately and on a different date. Those are not part of this group of ten.

dossiers.name: HELO1 DC
dossiers.summary: A Dickens County site that mined bitcoin under Argo. Galaxy bought it and now leases the whole of it to CoreWeave. Its row is the clearest proof on this site that a registry row names who holds a certification now rather than who held it when it was granted.

facts.label: Approved campus capacity CoreWeave has committed to lease
Critical IT load committed across the first three phases
Critical IT load delivered in the first phase
Gross power in service for that phase
Price Galaxy paid Argo for the site
Lease
facts.text: Fifteen years with two five year extension options

notes.text: The effective date on this row is years before Galaxy bought the site and years before CoreWeave leased it. Nothing is wrong with the row. The state rewrites the parties on a certification while keeping its original date, so a row names the present and dates the past. Every page here is written to that rule.
A second Helios certification exists under a later date and names the same occupant. The state spells the first one with a letter where the second uses a digit.
